wins.label: Strong cash generation

wins.label: Dividend payouts
wins.evidence: We paid out a fifth dividend in December of 2023, putting cash returned to shareholders through dividends at $1.02 billion for the full year.

wins.label: Digital Footprint growth
wins.evidence: Our Digital Footprint ended the year at 58% to 59% of sales.

wins.label: FMI device signing rate

wins.label: Operating margin improvement

wins.label: Record Operating Cash Flow
wins.evidence: Generated $354 million in operating cash in the fourth quarter of 2023 or $1.43 billion in operating cash for the full year.

wins.label: EPS Growth
wins.evidence: EPS of $0.46, up 8.4% from the fourth quarter of 2022.

wins.label: FMI Device Signing Growth
wins.evidence: FMI Technology. We had a good year with FMI. We did a really nice job of signing 24,126 MEUs, which divided by 253 days, is 95 per day.

wins.label: Digital Footprint Expansion
wins.evidence: Digital Footprint reached 58%, 59% type of neighborhood.

wins.label: Onsite Growth
wins.evidence: 58 signings in the fourth quarter of '23. We finished the year with 1,822 locations.

risks.label: Weak PMI Index
risks.evidence: Since November of 2022, we've seen a sub-50 PMI that when you operate very heavily in the industrial space, that's a big deal for you.

risks.label: Slow Onsite Signings
risks.evidence: 58 signings in the fourth quarter of '23. Perhaps, the environment came a little bit tougher late in the year for signing Onsite.

risks.label: Industrial Market Weakness
risks.evidence: Our manufacturing end market continues to grow, but at moderating rates, while our fastener product line experienced contraction in MRO and, for the first time this cycle, OEM products.

risks.label: Shipping Container Disruptions
risks.evidence: I think that when I think of 2023 and then going into 2024, so this is the last year that we've had -- that we'll have some branch closings.

risks.label: Uncertainty in Pricing
risks.evidence: Pricing was consistent and positive and within a typical range of 0% to 2%, with modest deflation within our fastener line.
